verdict.line: You lose if you stand in extended Q/auto trades before level 10; you win if you use Hallowed Mist to dictate when he can touch you and close the game with your Shadowflame/Rabadon's spike.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser wins the lane phase on paper — his Q outranges your cone, his passive aura rewards every exchange, and his W turns stored damage into a heal that outlasts your early trades. Your structural answer is Hallowed Mist: it forces him to physically walk into your zone to use Q or E on you, which flips who's committing in every skirmish. The 52.5% head-to-head over 863 games comes from closing that lane deficit with items and R, not from beating him in raw trades.

theirWindow.when: he's landed 2 hits, 1 from Darkness Rise
theirWindow.what: Back off the wave now. The third landed attack or spell gives him a damage aura and move speed burst — don't be the free fourth hit.

yourWindow.what: Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown and his only hard engage tool. On the whiff, use E (Skip 'n Slash) to dash in, get free autos under the attack-speed buff, then leave before his passive resets.

powerCurve.note: Q outranges your cone, passive punishes approaches
R isolates you for a stat-steal duel
Mist control and E pokes close the gap
Shadowflame/Rabadon's burst and healing outscale his flat damage

start.why: Run by 87.5% of Gwens into this matchup (52.1% WR, 913 games) — the extra sustain and ability haste matter more than armor here since nearly all of his damage is magic.

boots.why: Picked nearly 2x as often as Mercury's Treads here (48.9% vs 25.4% pick) and wins more (55.7% vs 49.8%) — he has no hard CC to itemize MR against, so take the penetration.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate path (62.2% over 201 games) — ability haste lets you reset W (Hallowed Mist) faster to re-zone him off you.
Second in the same path — the magic pen and burst help you punish the short windows his E is down before his W shield absorbs the damage.
Closes the 62.2% WR path — this is the item that actually flips the matchup, since your late burst finally outpaces his flat stat-steal from R.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need sustained damage to burn through his W (Indestructible) shield instead of one burst window
he's consistently landing R (Realm of Death) on you and you need a way to survive the isolation duel
you're already ahead and want attack speed to accelerate passive procs and E (Skip 'n Slash) cooldown resets

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking through the extended skirmishes this matchup forces gives you adaptive healing that offsets his W (Indestructible) sustain instead of letting him out-heal you for free.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 69.1% of these games and wins at 52.9% — Ignite punishes his W (Indestructible) healing when you do land a short trade. Flash+Teleport (54.5% WR, 7.4% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather scale safely and reset for waves instead of forcing early plays.

playing.title: Deny free autos before level 2
playing.detail: Without W (Hallowed Mist) up yet, his Q (8s cooldown at rank 1) and auto range beat your 450-range Q (Snip Snip!) — don't contest CS in direct trades this early.

playing.title: Soak waves inside your mist
playing.detail: Once W (Hallowed Mist) is up, position so he has to walk into it to use Q or E on you — any step he takes into the mist is him committing on your terms.

playing.title: Trade only after his E misses
playing.detail: Death's Grasp is his only hard engage and it's on a 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown. Punish the whiff with E (Skip 'n Slash), get your bonus attack speed autos in, then leave before his passive relands.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-10 all-in window
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) drags you into an isolated duel and steals your stats permanently if he kills you — ward the jungle entrances and don't overextend during this stretch even though your poke wants to.

playing.title: Track his passive stack, not just HP
playing.detail: Darkness Rise procs after 3 landed attacks or spells on you or nearby minions/camps, giving him a damage aura and move speed — back off the wave rather than be the third hit.

playing.title: Play for the item spike, not first blood
playing.detail: Your 52.5% win rate over 863 games comes from out-scaling him with Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap online, not from winning early exchanges — prioritize farm and item timers over forcing plays.

playing.title: Use E to disengage, not just engage
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's cooldown refunds on hit — use that reset to escape his extended W (Indestructible) sustain fights rather than only to initiate, since he out-tanks prolonged skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoner spells, and the 52.5% head-to-head figure over 863 games are measured from current-patch (16.19.1) games on OP.GG; the tactical reading — mist positioning, passive-stack tracking, and trade windows — is my own analysis, not sourced data.
